# E0308: translating an instance, a lens failed

This condition cannot arise when thema's checker is sound: every lens is proven total at bind, which rules out a result the target schema rejects for any instance (E0360, E0366, E0367).

If thema reports it, the bug is in thema, not in the lineage or the data.
Please report it at https://github.com/sdboyer/thema/issues with the lineage
and, for a translation, the instance.
